content: कर्णिकारः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree; Cassia fistula. The golden yellow flower of this tree has its petals bending inwards so that the flower looks like a saucer. Its stamens and style are longer than the petals and looks like so many wicks juttling {sic} out of an oil lamp. <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Vikr. 3. 3</ls>. निर्भिद्योपरि कर्णिकारमुकुलान्यालीयते षट्पदः <ls>V. 2. 23</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 6. 6</ls>, <ls n="Ṛs. 6.">20</ls>. .²2 The pericarp of a lotus. .{@-रम्@} A flower of the Karṇikāra tree. (This flower, though it has an excellent colour, has no smell and hence it is not liked; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ku. 3. 28</ls>; वर्णप्रकर्षे सति कर्णिकारं दुनोति निर्गन्धतया स्म चेतः . प्रायेण सामग्र्यविधौ गुणानां पराङ्मुखी विश्वसृजः प्रवृत्तिः ..).
